items.reason: The "Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma" experimental arm registers "Drug: ST101; Drug: Temozolomide; Radiation: Radiation", so radiotherapy is a partner along with temozolomide (coder A).

'unclear' is for records that do not settle the regimen; here the record is clear, so combination (consistent with other mixed-arm trials).
